protocol: Anonymous task/GT identity; input condition inferable. Case01 A/t1 prediction read before image; cases02–12 inspected before predictions. No mapping key opened. Historical visual familiarity possible.
reviewer: main Agent visual inspection, not independent human annotation
key_opened_after: all12 input observations and prediction comparison
scope: qualitative mechanism audit; no human accuracy estimate, no GT/task edits; confirmation cases cannot choose new method parameters

cases.evidence: T1 at lower tip of narrow pond; T2 lies on red/grey roofs. A/t1 prediction was accidentally read first; not prediction-blind for this one judgement.
cases.conclusion: 两条件均定位到池塘末端和后期屋顶，water→building与可见影像相容；本例A/t1预测先于看图，不能称预测盲审。

cases.evidence: Greenish thin strip in mixed vacant lot, then crosses two light rectangular roofs. T1 fine category uncertain.
cases.conclusion: 两条件均识别细条和后期屋顶；T1低植被/狭窄水体的视觉区分不可靠，不据类别标签把它机械判错。

cases.visible_before: bare/paved fragment at top image boundary
cases.evidence: White support lies at top border, NOT large central blue factory. Fine class uncertain in tiny clipped support; no evidence that support is the factory.
cases.conclusion: 两条件两期均描述中央大型工厂屋顶，而二值支持只在上边缘。这是可核查的区域错指，不依赖GT类别。

cases.visible_before: roof-edge strip or adjacent narrow structure
cases.evidence: Both show a narrow blue/bright line above the larger roof. Class/direction uncertain from tiny support, no confident land-cover transition.
cases.conclusion: 支持为极细屋顶边缘；两期都似屋顶或紧邻屋顶结构。回复泛化为大建筑，定位证据不充分；变化方向保留歧义。

cases.visible_before: low vegetation with possible small bushes
cases.evidence: Green textured support beside bare patch becomes light grey rough open ground, no visible roof.
cases.conclusion: A即B2在T2识别裸露地面，B即B1把粗糙地面说成矩形屋顶；B1有明确视觉误读。T1乔木/低植被细分类仍不确定。

cases.evidence: Blue angular roof footprint disappears; same supported position in a bounded green lawn/planting area.
cases.conclusion: 两条件均正确描述T形屋顶与后期绿地，支持对应明确。此例成功不能代表全部地表类。

cases.evidence: Bottom-left clipped fragment beside road; T2 blue-green uniform region. Do not describe central road or whole construction site as support.
cases.conclusion: B即B1描述右下方波浪/中心道路，实际支持在左下角，并错误引入SAR/backscatter解释；区域错指与影像模态幻觉。A即B2的T1位置更合理，T2水体分类可疑但本审查不强行改判。

cases.evidence: Irregular green crown by junction at T1; light rough cleared surface at T2.
cases.conclusion: 两条件T2均说低植被，图上更像清理后粗糙地面；受分辨率/季相影响，列为语义疑义，不据此宣称确定错误。

cases.evidence: Thin light strip between factory structures becomes a row of green crowns. Adjacent roofs excluded.
cases.conclusion: 两条件T2均描述大厂房屋顶，支持实际为细长绿化带/树冠。这是明确的区域错指；T1裸地/硬化地面/窄棚仍有歧义。

cases.evidence: Extremely thin line along industrial roof; both periods remain roof-associated. Direction and exact edge category ambiguous.
cases.conclusion: 回复描述整排建筑，支持只是一条极细边线；建筑类别可能相容，但不能确认新增变化或精确指代正确。

cases.evidence: Blue rectangular roof with two excluded holes becomes reddish/grey roof. Roof appearance changes, but no confident class transition.
cases.conclusion: 两期可见屋顶，类别building在视觉上相容；B2的T2文字转向邻近灰/蓝大屋顶，理由定位不足。解盲后原转换为building→non-vegetated，不自动改GT，标记影像/标签不一致待复核。

cases.evidence: Left clipped polygon on open pale surface, later dark tree crowns interspersed with paving. Central pyramid and surrounding roofs are outside support; no forced single class.
cases.conclusion: 两条件把支持中的开放铺地和后期树冠说成屋顶/空调设备，属于语义误读；后期支持本身混合树木与铺地，不能强行给独立单类真值。
